title: An AI agent wouldn't take "no" for an answer—and hacked into a government portal
description: An AI was supposed to search for health statistics—and ended up hacking into an Australian government portal. Personal data does not appear to have been compromised. But the outrage is widespread.

title: Tech leaders to UN: For the sake of humanity, please control the AI technology we created
description: For most of the world leaders, one key question about AI is this: Who should control life-and-death decisions — human or machine?

title: Apollo Global Management Sees AI, Private Credit and Retirement Driving Growth

title: Award-Winning French Author Accused Of Using AI to Write Debut Novel
description: An award-winning French literary sensation faces accusations of AI use, reigniting questions about unreliable detection tools and whether writers may increasingly have to prove their work is human.
